about: SHA-256 of the files of the second program for (48, 9, 5, 0, 2), one line per pivot orbit: the CNF formula, the DRAT proof of its unsatisfiability by CaDiCaL 1.9.5, and the LRAT proof that drat-trim writes from it. drat-trim and the LRAT checker lib/sat_certificate.py accepted every proof. An orbit marked "empty clause" is closed by counting cardinalities before the solver: its formula contains the empty clause and needs no proof. The command, run from this directory once for each I = 0, ..., 11, recreates the files and their checks; --discard-proofs removes the files of each orbit after its check, and without it they stay in DIR.

command.C8: "$SOLVER_PYTHON" -X utf8 checks/search48_second.py search --kind C8 --solver cadical --part I/12 --proof-dir DIR --proof-orbits all --discard-proofs --drat-timeout 900
command.2C4: "$SOLVER_PYTHON" -X utf8 checks/search48_second.py search --kind 2C4 --solver cadical --part I/12 --proof-dir DIR --proof-orbits all --discard-proofs --drat-timeout 900
